purpose: Screen embeddings for this lexical emotion-search task before making another model recommendation.
status: Assistant-authored screening cases, frozen before these model comparisons; not independently human-validated benchmark labels.
known_regression: The earlier fastText subword run placed heartened near disheartened. These checks are not a blind evaluation of that observation.
decision_rule: For each case, cosine(query, positive) must exceed cosine(query, negative) by more than 0.000001. Report every margin. Each group passes only if all its cases pass. Passing is necessary screening evidence, not proof of suitability or of an emotional composition law.
limitations: Positive and negative labels are explicit semantic judgments, not ground truth supplied by the operator.
Lexical checks use bare words; context checks test specified senses rather than declaring an ambiguous word to have only one valid meaning.
Join checks test whether descriptions retaining both emotions outrank descriptions dropping or reversing one; this does not implement a native witnessed join.
The fastText pretrained variants share the documented corpus family and dimension, but are not a randomized experiment isolating subword training alone.
